THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,

THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -3-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:13456  MFA No. 101733 of 2015  JUDGMENT
The appeal is filed by the claimant seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed on record.
3.
The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute.
4. In the present case the Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.10,000/- in globally, as the claimant has sustained two simple injuries.
Considering the nature of injury sustained by the claimant to the right lower back and right dorsal aspect.
For these injuries, the claimants might have been expended some amount and also for treatment and etc.,
Therefore, the compensation awarded by the tribunal is found to be lesser side.

Hence, it is just and proper to award additional compensation for a sum of Rs.10,000/- in addition to what has been awarded by the NC:
2023:KHC-D:13456 tribunal along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) Rest of the judgment awarded by the Tribunal holds good.
Hence, kept intact.

SD/-
